name: Trooper
character:
Your duty is to stand firm and fire your Lasgun as the enemies of the Imperium charge towards you. Follow orders in the face of the sanity-shredding terror and you'll make a fine Trooper.

Characteristics: +5 Toughness, +5 Ballistic Skill

Skill Advances: Athletics (1), Discipline (2), Ranged (2)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.8tlu4X5Qpzl98Uye]{Lasgun} and an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Dlv5TTOiyOJphsIl]{Entrenching Tool}

name: Canoness
patron:
Your Patron is a ranking commander amongst the Adepta Sororitas, a military master of the Adeptus Ministorum. She has authority over Sisters of Battle, though others often fall under her sway — Preachers, Crusaders, and Death Cult Assassins to name but a few.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.uT72W5ZHNDeLtGtM]{Purification Rituals}

name: Apprentice Genetor
character:
Your duty is to learn the intricacies of biological forms so that they may be improved upon by replacing the weakness of the flesh with the majesty of the machine.

Characteristics: +5 Intelligence, +5 Toughness

Skill Advances: Logic (1), Medicae (2), Tech (2)

Augmetics: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.HkhEg8qCUV0oZxOt]{Augmetic Sensory Organ} (one eye) and an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.6VeObvauzrXSw5nO]{Augmetic Heart}

name: Ganger
character:
Your duty is whatever your gang leader tells you to do, be that bashing in heads, scaring snitches, or moving goods. You don’t ask questions, you just get it done.

Characteristics: +5 Agility, +5 Toughness

Skill Advances: Dexterity (1), Rapport (1), Reflexes (1), Stealth (2)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.85opt2usT8oNSZyt]{Stub Pistol}, a set of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.LmBKbPMN8CsK4B3T]{Heavy Leathers}, an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.cnbaSByME7caQohv]{Axe} with the Shoddy and Ugly Flaws, and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.V2OgwHeEr3qpTbBy]{Stummer} with the Shoddy and Ugly Flaws.

name: Criminal Mastermind
patron:
Your Patron has thrived in the vicious criminal undergrounds of the @UUID[JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96]{Macharian Sector}, gaining significant power and resources and a desire for more.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.6JLGOSN04IfwkvZs]{Plausible Deniability}

name: Clerk
character:
Your duty is to preserve the data-vaults and archives of the Administratum, maintaining a working knowledge of huge amounts of information and applying it when required.

Characteristics: +5 Intelligence, +5 Fellowship

Skill Advances: Dexterity (1), Linguistics (1), Lore (2), Navigation (1)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rgkUmSGkBrOKvo5p]{Pict Recorder}

name: Scrivener
character:
Your duty is to correctly and meticulously record the ceaseless stream of data that the Administraum uses to manage the titanic bureaucracy of the Imperium.

Characteristics: +5 Intelligence, +5 Willpower

Skill Advances: Dexterity (1), Linguistics (2), Lore (2)

Equipment: An @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.wazqwH6rG3lKCQUR]{Auto-Quill}

name: Apprentice Logis
character:
Your duty is to gather, protect, analyse, and apply information of all kinds in the Omnissiah’s name.

Characteristics: +5 Intelligence, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Logic (2), Lore (1), Tech (2)

Augmetics: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.HkhEg8qCUV0oZxOt]{Augmetic Sensory Organ} (one eye) and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.AKyR6gu2VqFCimHq]{Augmetic Tracks/Wheels}

name: Melee Specialist
character:
Your duty is to charge the enemies of the Imperium and engage them in melee combat, a responsibility often assigned to recruits from less technologically advanced worlds.

Characteristics: +5 Toughness, +5 Weapon Skill

Skill Advances: Athletics (1), Discipline (1), Fortitude (1), Melee (2)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.jNxvsLBybPPenmmn]{Laspistol} and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.tjUKnuDKTCCon28r]{Chainsword}

name: Missionary
character:
Your duty is to spread the word of the Emperor's divinity across the stars, often on hostile worlds — and to hostile congregations.

Characteristics: +5 Willpower, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Discipline (1), Lore (1), Presence (1), Rapport (2)

Equipment: An @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.AfhkWSUYY9y6byiN]{Autopistol}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.tjUKnuDKTCCon28r]{Chainsword}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.4CglrWXiksan6Wk0]{Laud Hailer}, and 200 solars

name: Trader Militant
patron:
Your Patron is a Trader Militant, willing and even eager to exploit the military allowances within their warrant of trade to the fullest. They are a minor military force onto themselves, often overthrowing whole worlds to bring their populace — and their resources — into the Imperium.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.oXyZ2hmINFVN3EPT]{Voidship}

name: Aeronautica Pilot
character:
Your duty is to pilot aircraft for the Aeronautica Imperialis, a branch of the Navis Imperialis dedicated to providing in-atmosphere support for the forces of the Astra Militarum.

Characteristics: +5 Agility, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Awareness (1), Navigation (1), Piloting (2), Reflexes (1)

Equipment: a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.jNxvsLBybPPenmmn]{Laspistol}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.NlduMbxJZrKejC9J]{Photo-visors}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.YKdnnpcXv14ITvE5]{Void Suit}, and 500 solars.

name: Ordo Xenos Inquisitor
patron:
Your Patron is a servant of the Ordo Xenos, concerned with locating and purging inhuman taint wherever it is found. Many an Ork Waaagh! or Drukhari incursion has been averted by the subtle work of an Inquisitor and their acolytes. Some make use of xenos weaponry, turning the tools of their hated foes back upon them. Others view all technology conceived by inhuman minds as indelibly corrupt. Their successes are uncelebrated, while their failures have doomed billions.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3M9o35qxoxiQRzP5]{Limitless Authority}

name: Fixer
character:
Your duty is to be the ganger who has a solution for everything. Someones got a problem, maybe needs a bit of obscura, or a misunderstanding cleaned up? You're the one they call.

Characteristics: +5 Agility, +5 Fellowship

Skill Advances: Athletics (1), Dexterity (1), Rapport (2), Stealth (1)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.vCeI41URKYV6iuAD]{Stub Revolver}, a set of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.D9X5jPYYafLyPqKh]{Light Leathers}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.1WGY0CCdLBdJx6se]{Hammer} with the Shoddy and Ugly Flaws, and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.JqK0ohbnuujGTVTE]{Lascutter} with the Shoddy and Ugly Flaws.

name: Guildmaster
patron:
Your Patron is the master of a guild, a form of trade organisation permitted on certain worlds as a means of controlling and directing labourers. Though their authority is typically very narrow, many Guildmasters are keen to expand their influence.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Sdrdzx7KmkZiuh0B]{Registered Trader}

name: Lord-Commissar
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking member of the Commissariat, a political officer of such legendary stature and achievement that they have risen to a powerful position, responsible for ensuring morale is maintained at the highest levels. This includes watching for corruption, incompetence, and outright heresy among the officers of the regiment.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.E6PjpL6Ysup9g9AJ]{Fearsome Reputation}

name: Arch-Confessor
patron:
Your Patron is a zealous priest of the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.PdQjDIH5C6kx3vAy]{Adeptus Ministorum}, an exemplar of fervent faith in the Emperor. They are dedicated to uncovering any trace of heresy that lurks within the Imperium, and may have authority over the citizens of a single hive, a whole world, or even an entire subsector.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.iyNmjADrdcSql6jM]{Ecclesiarchal Shrine}

name: Port Commander
patron:
Your Patron is the sovereign ruler of a voidport, the absolute authority of an invaluable transport hub of the Macharian Sector. They may be responsible for a planetside spaceport or a stellar void station, but in either case their word is law. A Port Commander is wholly responsible for their voidport, and is invested with the power to gather information and search or even detain ships in pursuit of the Emperor's enemies.

Merchant Fleet ports are most concerned with assessing and transporting goods while offering voidships a chance to refuel, whereas Navis Imperialis ports are focused defensive positions or staging areas for bitter conflict.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.tct4xpbh6d7XaL6X]{Voidport Peerage}

name: Navis Officer
character:
Your duty is to aid in ensuring that discipline and the chain of command are maintained aboard a voidship. Though your rank is not high, you nevertheless form a vital part of your captain's command structure.

Characteristics: +5 Agility, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Awareness (2), Navigation (1), Reflexes (2)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.jNxvsLBybPPenmmn]{Laspistol}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.YKdnnpcXv14ITvE5]{Void Suit}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.NlduMbxJZrKejC9J]{Photo-contacts}, an Officers Uniform (@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.D9X5jPYYafLyPqKh]{Light Leathers} with the Ornamental Quality), and 480 solars.

name: Diplomat
patron:
Your Patron is a Rogue Trader devoted to negotiating with societies within and beyond the Imperium, bridging the gaps between Factions (and even Species in rare circumstances) in the name of profit.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.oXyZ2hmINFVN3EPT]{Voidship}

name: Magos Biologis
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking Tech-Priest, an experienced master Genetor specialising in the study and manipulation of biological life.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Tg0tXahB0KNtPyLV]{Ameliorator}

name: Apprentice Enginseer
character:
Your duty is to divine the mysteries of Machine Spirits and work with the Holy Engines of the Omnissiah, repairing and maintaining machines of war.

Characteristics: +5 Intelligence, +5 Agility.

Skill Advances: Logic (1), Piloting (2), Tech (2)

Augmetics: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.gMiilnjEIZawYcfG]{Augmetic Respiratory System} and an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.zK3ii7HUPfnQGKtg]{Augmetic Arm}.

name: Forge Lord
patron:
Your Patron is an Artisan Magos, capable of maintaining ancient technology and overseeing the production of Omnissiah-approved patterns.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.opCfLwJw2T80Nsdq]{Manufactorum Master}

name: Armsman
character:
Your duty is to defend your voidship and follow your Captain's orders, performing any tasks they may require and laying down your life for the vessel if necessary.

Characteristics: +5 Agility, +5 Toughness

Skill Advances: Awareness (1), Logic (1), Navigation (1), Piloting (1), Reflexes (1)

Equipment: a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.g6dWis6NUm1JXxzK]{Flak Vest}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.JqK0ohbnuujGTVTE]{Lascutter}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.tNz22cmtCLm6XPLs]{Mag Boots}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.NLKRLMgcYzandwsL]{Pump-action Shotgun}, and 500 solars.

name: Catalogist
character:
Your duty is to explore on behalf of a Rogue Trader Dynasty, documenting flora, fauna, individuals, and environments that might be profitably exploited.

Characteristics: +5 Fellowship, +5 Intelligence

Skill Advances: Intuition (1), Linguistics (1), Navigation (2), Piloting (1)

Equipment: an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.wazqwH6rG3lKCQUR]{Auto-Quill}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.B55qG1YQTS9IyuTm]{Backpack}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Aw29y9tfO4Uc9uWb]{Chrono}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.h1g1g9Rrjt7CnYeW]{Dataslate}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.rgkUmSGkBrOKvo5p]{Pict Recorder}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.D9X5jPYYafLyPqKh]{Robes}, and 700 solars.

name: Black Ship Crewmember
character:
Despite your lack of psychic ability, you have developed the mental fortitude to weather the terrors of the Warp. Your duty is to keep order on the ominous Black Ships of the Adeptus Astra Telepathica, the vessels that ferry captured psykers to the Scholastica Psykana on Terra.

Characteristics: +5 Willpower, +5 Toughness

Skill Advances: Awareness (1), Discipline (2), Intuition (2)

Talents: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.TXMKTpI3FosIpc3O]{Condemn the Witch} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.A8gHIdJY3Va9OrhM]{Mental Fortress}

name: Ordo Hereticus Inquisitor
patron:
Your Patron serves the Ordo Hereticus, rooting out heresy in all its form. Rogue Psykers, heretical preachers, and secretive cultists have all met a grisly end at the hands of an Ordo Hereticus Inquisitor. For every traitor they have uncovered, however, a dozen more worm their way ever closer to the heart of the Imperium.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3M9o35qxoxiQRzP5]{Limitless Authority}

name: Sister-In-Waiting
character:
Your duty as a Blank is to become a Sister of Silence and hunt Rogue Psykers, though you have not yet sworn the Vow of Tranquillity and may still speak aloud.

Characteristics: +5 Willpower, +5 Toughness

Skill Advances: Awareness (2), Discipline (2), Navigation (1)

Talent: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.PpidBBZ7dG6yziXg]{Blank}

name: Sister Novitiate
character:
Your duty is to serve the faithful sisterhood of the Adepta Sororitas, as a diplomat, medic, or warrior, as your talents dictate.

Characteristics: +5 Willpower, +5 Intelligence

Skill Advances: Discipline (2), Lore (1), Medicae (2)

Equipment: An @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.AfhkWSUYY9y6byiN]{Autopistol}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.I2J8NfYpRkKTshku]{Carapace Chestplate}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.qjjlckQ3WvF4KLxO]{Chirurgeon's Kit}, and 200 solars

name: Acolyte
character:
Your duty is to investigate on behalf of the Inquisition, working to deduce the identities of the enemies of the Imperium as well as where and how they are operating.

Characteristics: +5 Perception, +5 Toughness

Skill Advances: Awareness (1), Discipline (1), Intuition (1), Logic (1), Presence (1)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.ypTbWrEOkiGLSsm1]{Comm Leech}

name: Scout
character:
Your duty is to perform reconnaissance and covert operations for the Astra Militarum, ranging far behind enemy lines.

Characteristics: +5 Toughness, +5 Ballistic Skill

Skill Advances: Athletics (1), Melee (1), Ranged (1), Stealth (2)

Equipment: a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.fhXBHDbBiY6PUUTc]{Cameleoline cloak} and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.hWEzRGbvoBrhgKwJ]{Las Carbine}.

name: Voidship Captain
patron:
Your Patron is the commander of a voidship and its innumerable crew, the ruler of a vessel that can travel between worlds. They may be a Chartist Captain, transferring titanic cargoes of crucial resources, or they may be part of the Navis Imperialis, ferrying troopers to war zones whilst wielding titanic arsenals capable of scorching whole worlds.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.oXyZ2hmINFVN3EPT]{Voidship}

name: Sister of Silence
patron:
Your Patron is a Knight-Centura, a Sister of Silence, a ranking member of an ancient order cursed with the Pariah gene and sworn to silence. She may accompany or even command a Black Ship, hunting psykers throughout the Imperium, or otherwise protect the Imperium from Psychic threats.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.ZQVEe1jI680zL964]{Null Sanctum}

Sworn To Silence

Full Sisters of Silence never speak aloud, and often communicate through a complex system of sign language known as Thoughtmark, though a streamlined language known as Battlemark is used to relay crucial information quickly during combat. A Sister of Silence will typically retain a Sister-in-waiting to translate this secret language for the characters, though one of the players may wish to play a Sister-in-waiting themselves to perform this function.

name: Sage
character:
Your duty is to provide information to the Inquisition, using your vast knowledge to solve problems, make deductions, and provide context for clues.

Characteristics: +5 Perception, +5 Intelligence

Skill Advances: Intuition (1), Logic (2), Lore (2)

Equipment: An @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.dO7XoDXD9QYTy6zZ]{Auspex}

name: Astropath
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking Astropath, perhaps the Head of an Astropathic Choir, soul-bound to the Emperor of Mankind. Their duty is to communicate across the void of space via the tumultuous warp, projecting images into another Astropath’s mind and interpreting the response in kind.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.niqxBVj5cdI03Woj]{Astropathic Communication}

name: Senior Officer
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking executive officer of the Astra Militarum, assuming command of an entire regiment of troops and war machines.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.jVqhxWe0o7nWz3Qj]{Seconded Troopers}

name: Preacher
character:
Your duty is to deliver zealous oratory on the teachings of the Imperial Creed, inspiring, encouraging, and terrifying the masses into serving the Emperor.

Characteristics: +5 Willpower, +5 Fellowship

Skill Advances: Intuition (1), Lore (1), Presence(2), Rapport (1)

Equipment: a book containing extracts from the Lectitio Divinatus (a Holy Icon), a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.bYYdQ2TEdSgOTIf0]{Staff with the Ornamental Quality}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.4CglrWXiksan6Wk0]{Laud Hailer}, and 590 solars

name: Officio Medicae
character:
Your duty is to ensure an acceptable baseline of health in the Imperial populace, ensuring that Medicae are stocked and patients seen, in order to keep up productivity.

Characteristics: +5 Intelligence, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Dexterity (1), Logic (1), Lore (1), Medicae (2)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.qjjlckQ3WvF4KLxO]{Chirurgeon's Kit}

name: Sanctioned Psyker
character:
Your duty is to use your reality-bending powers to assist an Imperial Faction, typically by unleashing the devastating powers of the Warp in the theatre of war with the Astra Militarum.

Characteristics: +5 Willpower, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Awareness (1), Discipline (2), Psychic Mastery (2)

Talents: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3GLGsYiH5LiKgYjE]{Psyker} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.6fGIyNI86dmgxwGG]{Sanctioned Psyker}

name: Adventurer
character:
Your duty is to expand the frontiers of the Imperium; through charm and negotiation if possible, by force if necessary.

Characteristics: +5 Fellowship, +5 Agility

Skill Advances: Intuition (1), Navigation (1), Presence (2), Rapport (1)

Equipment: an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.AfhkWSUYY9y6byiN]{Autopistol} and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.I2J8NfYpRkKTshku]{Carapace Chestplate} with the Ornamental Quality and the Bulky Flaw.

name: Exorcist
character:
Your duty is to provide spiritual support to an Inquisitor's retinue, utilising your knowledge of scripture and your strength of will to combat the unholy enemies of the Imperium.

Characteristics: +5 Perception, +5 Willpower

Skill Advances: Awareness (1), Discipline (1), Intuition (1), Lore (1), Presence (1)

Equipment: An @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.dO7XoDXD9QYTy6zZ]{Auspex}

name: Departmento Munitorum Ordinate
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking official of the Departmento Munitorum, the logistical sub-division of the Administratum responsible for ensuring the armies of the Astra Militarum are raised, armed, and armoured, then liaising with the Navis Imperialis to ferry these warriors to the battlefield.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.L3kIcGE0xpebmNbA]{Munitorum Depot}

name: Diplomat
character:
Your duty is to negotiate on behalf of a Rogue Trader Dynasty, interacting with other Imperial Factions, outsiders, and potentially even xenos.

Characteristics: +5 Fellowship, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Intuition (1), Presence (1), Linguistics (1), Rapport (2)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Aw29y9tfO4Uc9uWb]{Chrono}, a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.uSlUGjAxn1v6DvhG]{Regicide Set}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.D9X5jPYYafLyPqKh]{Robes} with the Ornamental Quality, a set of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.B55qG1YQTS9IyuTm]{Slings}, and 1,100 solars.

name: Tithe Prefectus
patron:
Your Patron is a high-ranking official of the @UUID[JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.KphmdOYxm3Xl9I4i]{Adeptus Administratum} tasked with ensuring the titanic tithes of the worlds of the @UUID[JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96]{Macharian Sector} are delivered and the Emperor is paid His due. The exact nature of the tithe varies from world to world, with some providing food or processed ores, while others provide desperately needed manufactured goods. Regardless of its form, the size of the tithe is always onerous, calculated to be nothing less than everything the planet can spare.

Duty Boon: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.YFMKd1NYhlAS5JK7]{Tithe Inspection}

name: Hiverunner
character:
Your duty is to move things quickly and quietly for your gang, be it information, messages, stolen goods, or illicit materials.

Characteristics: +5 Agility, +5 Perception

Skill Advances: Athletics (2), Fortitude (1), Reflexes (1), Stealth (1)

Equipment: A @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.85opt2usT8oNSZyt]{Stub Pistol}, a set of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.D9X5jPYYafLyPqKh]{Light Leathers}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.Ka2JVAFAOaWr4xIR]{Brass Knuckles} with the Shoddy and Ugly Flaws, and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.iG45nxwOAfNkpKYJ]{Grapnel Launcher} with the Shoddy and Ugly Flaws.
